properties.answer: Approved (Anthony, 2026-07-25). A claim carries the session that made it — the harness session id, assigned out of band so it cannot race — and claim_report distinguishes a live claim from one left by a session that closed. Liveness computed, not asserted.
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A claim names its owner, and a claim with no live owner is reported stale”
properties.question: When somebody says “I have got this part”, should reflow2 record WHO said it and then tell you when that person is no longer around — so the list shows what is actually being worked on rather than what somebody claimed days ago and walked away from? Today a claim carries only a label, so an abandoned claim looks exactly like a live one.
